_help: The ONE big tutorial (ONBOARD-1, TUT-2). One entry per step, in the order they are offered; the player may do them in any order. id = the step and the event that ticks it off (client calls guide.event(id)). target = what the animated pointer sits on: furniture (typeId, first one in the room; when it stands in the kitchen or cellar the pointer shows the door), door (an Inn door of the room you stand in, by id), guest (a waiting guest), stand (the tap stand when the avatar waits to pour, else a waiting guest), coins (coins on a table), ui (a button by its aria-label start), floor (a spot of floor beside the avatar), none. text uses {Tap} (Tap or Click), {tap}, {hold} (Hold your finger on / Hold the mouse button on) so one line serves touch and mouse. short = the one line of the folded card on a phone (RUN 5; a tap on the card shows the full text). Update this file and docs/GUIDE-UPDATE.md when a first-ten-minutes flow changes.

steps.text: {Tap} the floor to walk there. Keep {hold} the floor and your avatar follows.
{Tap} the register on the bar to open the menu: serve, set prices, sell.
A guest wants a drink. {Tap} the guest, then {hold} the tap stand until the mug is full.
{Tap} the guest who waits to bring them the mug.
The guest eats, then pays: the coins fly into your register by themselves.
steps.short: Wait for the guest to pay

steps.text: {Tap} the kitchen door at the back of the tavern. This is where you brew and cook.
{Tap} the brewing barrel in the kitchen and start a brew for more drinks.
steps.short: Start a brew at the barrel

steps.text: The brew is ready: {tap} the barrel to collect the mugs.
Back in the tavern, {tap} a tap stand and load the mugs on it.
{Tap} the cellar door and put mugs on a keg rack. Mugs left to ripen sell for more.
{Tap} the stove in the kitchen and cook a dish for the menu.
{Tap} Worlds and visit your farm: crops grow there while you play.
{Tap} Catalog, buy turnip seeds, pick them in the hotbar, {tap} a soil cell.
Plants grow in real time. Punch a full plant to harvest it; press and hold to keep hitting.
{Tap} Build to move furniture and place new pieces.
{Tap} Catalog, pick a wall piece (banner, mirror) and hang it on the back wall.
{Tap} Dungeon to fight for loot. One hit per {tap}, so go fast!
Level 3 opens the mine. {Tap} Worlds and go mining: ore becomes bars at the forge.
{Tap} Worlds and walk to the lakeside: chop trees for wood and fish in the lake.
{Tap} the water to cast, {tap} again at the "!", then hold to keep the fish in the box.

done: Nice, that is one more done.
allDone: You know the tavern now. Have fun, tavern keeper!
